newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George - Rate rise to moderate UK economy.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George - Rate rise to moderate UK economy.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Wednesday he welcomed UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke's decision to raise interest rates by a quarter-point.
"Moving now to moderate the accelerating pace of the economic upswing is likely to mean that we will need to tighten policy by less than we would otherwise," George said.
George said the rate rise improved the chances of meeting the government's 2.5 percent target for underlying inflation and of sustaining economic expansion into the medium-term.
